purpose: Forensic discrepancy register and remediation mapping for independent review findings of CTO Directive 108.
governance: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.2 / Rule IV-001 (Non-Self-Acceptance)

discrepancies.priorReportValue: Directive 108 split verification functions into scripts/internal/reconcile_engine.mjs, which imported 18 symbols from scripts/reconcile_execution_ledger.mjs, while scripts/reconcile_execution_ledger.mjs imported internal functions from reconcile_engine.mjs. This created a mutual circular module dependency in Node ECMAScript module resolution.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Pure root verification payload functions (verifyHistoricalArtifactIntegrityPayload, verifyAuthorityBoundaryPayload, verifyGoverningSpecificationProvenancePayload, reconcileExecutionLedgerCore) are authored directly in scripts/reconcile_execution_ledger.mjs with ZERO internal imports. tests/helpers/ledger-test-adapter.mjs imports these pure payloads to execute controlled fixtures. scripts/internal/reconcile_engine.mjs re-exports from ledger-test-adapter.mjs for backward compatibility without creating any reference back to reconcile_execution_ledger.mjs. Module graph is an absolute DAG with 0 cycles.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Refactoring of internal verification functions in Directive 108 without process-isolated acyclicity validation.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directive 108 created scripts/internal/reconcile_engine.mjs to extract shared logic but retained mutual imports between the public verifier and internal engine.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Consolidated core payload execution inside scripts/reconcile_execution_ledger.mjs, updated tests/helpers/ledger-test-adapter.mjs to consume them directly, decoupled scripts/internal/reconcile_engine.mjs, and verified acyclicity in clean separate Node processes (Suite 30 Check 1.3).

discrepancies.affectedEntity: Threat model documentation, public production verifier, and repository import graph
discrepancies.priorReportValue: Directive 108 reports suggested that directory naming (scripts/internal/) and underscore prefixes (_verify*Internal) constituted an authorization or security boundary, and discussed arbitrary same-process imports as potential vulnerabilities without demonstrating application reachability.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Formally documented authentic threat model distinguishing: (1) Public production verifier interface (safe-by-default, rejects all 10 FORBIDDEN_TRUST_OVERRIDES); (2) Internal module interfaces (ECMAScript export conventions, non-production seams); (3) Test harness used to exercise adversarial fixtures; (4) Genuine runtime boundaries (OS process isolation, air-gap, production DB isolation). Shipped application code (apps/api, apps/mobile, packages/) does not import test adapters or verification scripts. Same-process imports are developer/CI tools, not remotely reachable attack surfaces.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Conflating syntactic/file-structure conventions with language-level privacy or runtime authorization boundaries in report narrative.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directive 108 introduced scripts/internal/ to isolate test fixtures, which was critiqued in review for overstating file-path privacy.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Documented formal threat model in Directive 109 implementation report and discrepancy register. Verified application codebase reachability in Suite 30 Test 3.6 confirming zero test adapter imports in shipped code.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: All passing test suites in the manifest had testsSkipped: 0, which could be misconstrued as independent affirmative proof of zero skipped tests across all suites, even though legacy test suites did not report skipped counts.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Strict tri-state skipped counting preserved in manifest and validator: SKIPPED_COUNT_NOT_REPORTED (zeroSkippedEvidenced: false) for 23 legacy custom suites where runner output omitted skipped counts, and EXPLICIT_ZERO_SKIPPED (zeroSkippedEvidenced: true) only where runner contract or explicit summary outputs guaranteed zero skipped (4 Jest suites and Directives 107-109). Aggregate qualification maintained strictly as REPOSITORY_RECORDED_EXECUTION.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Defaulting missing runner skipped counts to numeric 0 without qualifying whether zero was evidenced or unevidenced.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directives 107 and 108 introduced skippedState and zeroSkippedEvidenced fields, but evidence qualification language needed full reconciliation.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Maintained explicit skippedState and zeroSkippedEvidenced validation in scripts/capture_test_execution.mjs and verified in Suite 30 Tests 5.1-5.4.
